senses.gloss: --the king of Sindhu--सौवीर kingdom: employed जड-Bharata as his palanquin bearer, and found fault with him for not bearing it properly: He understood that he was a Brahmana, felt remorse and enquired who he was. Heard precepts on आत्मविद्या from Bharata and became devoted to Hari in a spirit of detachment. भा. V. १०. 1-२५; १३. २५.
--a clan belonging to Rohita प्रजापति. वा. १००. ६१.
--son of शुद्धोदन, and father of Prasenajit. वा. ९९. २८९; Vi. IV. २२. 8.
